title: Keybound Brawler Arrives October 28!
raw:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459756/131f3325fa1fcb8cce830cb5443ef5d4b8c46c04.png[/img]

Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459756/08f719154a8fb24e5906333de22d86bc6276ea39.jpg[/img]
Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

[h3]Event Duration[/h3]
From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT)
to the release of Patch 8.0

[b]* The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.[/b]

[h3]How to Participate[/h3]
Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0).

[i]* Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest.
* Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy."
* Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states.[/i]

[b]* Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.[/b]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459756/ca2a40d41bb65f8d14ea6a2ad9c850de26a0fc85.png[/img]
[i]* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals.[/i]

[url=https://sqex.to/zfxMP style=button]Visit the special site for more details.[/url]
